whatItDoes:
SHALL THE TOWN OF LAKE CITY’S REGULAR MUNICIPAL ELECTION BE
MOVED FROM THE FIRST TUESDAY IN APRIL OF EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS TO
THE TUESDAY IN NOVEMBER OF EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS WHEN GENERAL
STATEWIDE ELECTIONS ARE HELD TO PROMOTE INCREASED VOTER
PARTICIPATION, REDUCE TOWN ELECTION EXPENSES, AND ALLOW THE
TOWN TO PARTICIPATE IN ELECTIONS COORDINATED BY HINSDALE
COUNTY?

Section 5. Effect of Voter Approval
If a majority of the registered electors voting on the ballot question vote in favor of the
question, the question shall be deemed to have passed and shall be effective upon adoption of an
ordinance changing the regular municipal election date, beginning with the Town’s regular
municipal election in November of 2028.

parts:
WHEREAS, consistent with C.R.S. § 31-10-109, if a majority of the registered electors
voting on the question support a change in the election date, the Board of Trustees anticipates: (i)
entering into an intergovernmental agreement with Hinsdale County before each municipal
election, or participating in whatever other process is required by Hinsdale County, to allow
 Hinsdale County to conduct the Town’s municipal elections during coordinated elections; and (ii)
adopting an ordinance (a) changing the election date for regular municipal elections from the
first Tuesday in April of even-numbered years to the Tuesday following the first Monday in
November of even-numbered years, beginning in November of 2028, and (b) extending the terms
of office of the Trustees of the Town Board elected during the April 2, 2024 election from April
2028 to November of 2028 and those elected during the April 7, 2026 election from April of
2030 to November of 2030 to ensure that their terms are not shortened; and

reviewNotes: The adopted official referral gives the question text itself as the ballot title but does not assign a final measure number. OfficialNumber is omitted rather than invented from an unofficial guide.

June17adoption minutes separately record passage of both referrals. The minutes call2026-08 an ordinance while repeating the exact election-date caption; the primary document is explicitly Resolution2026-08. This clerical label does not change the quoted question.

The date change beginsNovember2028 and takes effect through a later implementing ordinance. The board-size change begins with the2028municipal election and preserves current elected terms; no dependency between the two questions is invented.

whatItDoes:
SHALL THE NUMBER OF TRUSTEES ON THE TOWN OF LAKE CITY BOARD OF
TRUSTEES BE REDUCED FROM SIX TO FOUR, TO TAKE EFFECT BEGINNING
WITH THE TOWN’S 2028 MUNICIPAL ELECTION, IN ORDER TO PROMOTE
MORE EFFICIENT TOWN GOVERNANCE AND REDUCE THE DIFFICULTY OF
FILLING ELECTED POSITIONS?

Section 5. Effect of Voter Approval.
 If a majority of the registered electors voting on the ballot question vote in favor of the
question, the question shall be deemed to have passed. The number of trustees on the Board of
Trustees shall be reduced from six to four, and the legislative and corporate authority of the
Town shall thereafter be vested in the Board of Trustees consisting of one mayor and four
trustees.
Approval of the ballot question shall not have the effect of reducing or shortening the
term for which any member of the Board of Trustees was previously elected. The reduction shall
be implemented in accordance with applicable law and in a manner that preserves the full elected
terms of current trustees.

WHEREAS, if a majority of the registered electors voting on the question approve the
reduction in the number of trustees, the Board of Trustees shall consist of one mayor and four
trustees, three trustees shall constitute a quorum for the transaction of business, and the reduction
shall be implemented in a manner that does not shorten the term for which any member of the
Board of Trustees was previously elected; and
